story: Still working at a call centre in Noida, UP. Salary for July, August and September 2026 not paid, Rs 18,000 a month. Manager keeps saying next week.

facts.user_goal: Get the pending salary for July, August and September 2026
missing: Proof of employment or salary slips

rules.name: monthly_due_date
rules.message: Wages for July 2026 were due before the end of 07 August 2026 (the 7th of the next month).
rules.label: When wages were due

rules.name: wage_claim_limitation
rules.message: File your wage claim before 07 Aug 2029 (1003 days left). This counts 3 years from 07 Aug 2026 (when July 2026 wages fell due; each later month has its own, later deadline). Don't wait for the last date.
rules.label: Last date to file your wage claim

rules.name: where_to_claim
rules.message: You (or your union) can file a claim before the wage authority. For banks, railways, telecom, mines, insurance and central PSUs this is the Central Government's authority; for other employers it is your State labour department. It can order up to ten times the claim as compensation and recovers unpaid amounts like land revenue. The employer has to prove they paid you.
rules.label: Where to claim

rules.name: amount
rules.message: Unpaid wages: 3 month(s) x Rs 18,000 = Rs 54,000 (before any lawful deductions; HRA and overtime also count as wages for payment).
rules.label: Amount

answer.summary: Your employer must pay your full salary for July, August, and September 2026. You can file a wage claim to recover your unpaid Rs 54,000. The employer has to prove they paid you, and the wage authority can order them to pay up to ten times your claim. Do not wait for the last date to file.

claims.text: You are an employee and your unpaid salary counts as wages.
You can file a wage claim for your unpaid Rs 54,000 before the wage authority.
The employer has to prove they paid you the full wage amount.
The wage authority can order the employer to pay compensation up to ten times the claim amount.

next_steps.action: Collect proof of employment and salary.
next_steps.why: You need this to show you worked and earned the salary.

next_steps.action: File a wage claim with the State Labour Department in Uttar Pradesh.
next_steps.why: This is the correct authority for private call centres in UP. It can recover your money and order extra compensation.
You have 1003 days left from the July wage due date. Do not wait.

next_steps.action: Call 15100 for free legal aid if you need help with the claim.
next_steps.why: You may qualify for free legal help based on your income.

I was employed with you at a monthly wage of Rs 18,000. My wages for July 2026 to September 2026 have not been paid.

Yours faithfully,
[FILL: your name and signature]

draft_notes:
How to send it:
1. Find their correct address in your offer letter, salary slip, or the company's registered office on the MCA website (mca.gov.in).
2. Fill every [FILL] slot. Remove anything that isn't true - only state facts you can prove.
3. Send by Speed Post and keep the receipt and the tracking proof of delivery. Also send a copy by email or WhatsApp and keep a screenshot.
4. Wait 15 days. Sending this letter does NOT stop any legal time limit - file your claim/complaint before the deadline shown, even if they haven't replied.
5. Free help to check the letter: legal aid 15100 or Tele-Law 14454.

Laws this letter relies on: Code on Wages, 2019, s.17(1)-(4) (Time limit for payment of wages); Code on Wages, 2019, s.45(1)-(6) (Claims authority, compensation, recovery and time limit); Code on Wages, 2019, s.59 (Burden of proof on employer); Code on Wages, 2019, s.2(d) (Central or State Government: whose authority applies); Code on Wages, 2019, s.2(y) (main part, clauses (a)-(j)) (What counts as "wages")
